name: Sub-3:15 Marathon Plan
revision: 2026-09-04 — long-run progression reworked (18/18 pre-Scotland, 18/20/20 in wks 11-13)

paces.name: Easy / Recovery
paces.note: Conversational. Discipline here builds the engine.

paces.name: Long run
paces.note: Relaxed; MP segments only where listed.

paces.name: Tempo
paces.note: Comfortably hard — could speak a sentence, not a paragraph.

paces.name: Strides
paces.note: Smooth acceleration, full recovery. Not sprints.

A.title: Strength A — 30 min (dumbbells)
A.note: Rest 60–90 sec between sets. Last 2 reps hard but clean; add 5 lb when all sets feel easy.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.how: Hold one DB vertically against your chest, elbows tucked. Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out. Sit hips down and back until thighs are parallel, chest tall, then drive up through the whole foot.
exercises.cue: Knees track over toes — don’t let them cave inward.

exercises.name: DB Romanian Deadlift
exercises.how: DBs in front of thighs, slight knee bend. Push hips straight back, sliding DBs to mid-shin with a flat back. Squeeze glutes to stand.
exercises.cue: It’s a hip hinge, not a squat — feel the hamstrings load.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.how: DBs at sides. Step one foot back, lower until both knees hit ~90°, front shin vertical. Push through the front heel to return. All reps one leg, then switch.
exercises.cue: Torso upright; the front leg does the work.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
exercises.how: One foot on a step edge, heel hanging off, fingertips on wall for balance. Lower heel below the step, pause, rise as high as you can. 3 sec down.
exercises.cue: Runners’ gold: strong calves injury-proof the Achilles.

exercises.name: One-Arm DB Row
exercises.how: Hand and knee on bench, back flat like a table. Pull the DB to your hip, elbow skimming your ribs. Lower with control.
exercises.cue: Pull with the back, not the bicep — no torso twisting.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.how: Standing, DBs at shoulders. Brace your core and press straight overhead to lockout by your ears. Lower with control.
exercises.cue: Ribs down, no back-arching — squeeze glutes for a stable base.

exercises.name: Plank (finisher)
exercises.how: Forearms down, elbows under shoulders, body one straight line head to heels. Squeeze glutes and brace abs.
exercises.cue: Don’t let hips sag or pike. Shaking is fine; sagging isn’t.

B.title: Strength B — 20 min (lighter)
B.note: Keep legs fresh for Saturday’s long run — smooth reps, no grinding.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.how: Staggered stance, feet hip-width apart (not tightrope). Drop the back knee straight down, then drive up. All reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: DB Hip Hinge
exercises.how: Same movement as the RDL but lighter and a touch faster up. Hips back, flat back, snap hips forward to stand.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.how: Hands just wider than shoulders, body rigid. Chest to an inch off the floor, elbows ~45° from ribs. Elevate feet if easy, hands on bench if hard.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.how: On one forearm, elbow under shoulder, feet stacked, body in one line. Push hips up and hold.
exercises.cue: Glute med — fights late-race form collapse.

exercises.name: Calf Raise (both legs)
exercises.how: Both feet on step edge, rise, pause 1 sec, lower slowly below level. Hold DBs to add load.

CORE.title: Core Day — 15 min (after run)
CORE.note: Run through as a circuit with minimal rest.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.how: Forearm plank, straight line head to heels, glutes tight.
exercises.cue: Progress by +10 sec, not by holding a saggy minute.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.how: Elbow under shoulder, feet stacked, hips high.
exercises.cue: To progress: raise the top leg.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.how: On your back, arms up, knees over hips. Press low back into the floor. Slowly lower opposite arm and leg, return, switch.
exercises.cue: If your low back arches off the floor, shorten the reach.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.how: On all fours, extend opposite arm and leg parallel to the floor, pause 2 sec, return.
exercises.cue: No hip rotation — balance a coffee mug on your low back.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.how: On your back, feet flat near hips. Drive through heels to a knees–hips–shoulders line, pause 1 sec.
exercises.cue: Feel it in glutes, not hamstrings — feet closer if not.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.how: Seated, lean back ~45° with a straight spine, rotate side to side. Light DB to progress; feet up = harder.
exercises.cue: Rotate from the trunk, not just the arms.

BW.title: Scotland Bodyweight Circuit — 20 min
BW.note: 3 rounds, minimal rest. Any hotel room works. Skip after big hike days.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.how: Same form as goblet squat, hands out front for balance.

exercises.name: Alternating Lunge
exercises.how: Forward or reverse — whatever the floor space allows.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.how: Strict form, chest to an inch off the floor.

exercises.name: Step-Up
exercises.how: Onto a sturdy chair or bench. Drive through the top heel.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.how: Straight line, glutes tight.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
exercises.how: Off a stair edge.
